title: Find the policy that answers a question
outcome: Rank vectors, test boundaries, and compare retrieval approaches.
story: Amina’s assistant needs the returns policy for a returns question. Search must find the right shop’s current document before an answer can use it.

frames.explanation: An embedding represents text as numbers used for similarity ranking.
Always returning a document can produce an unsupported answer.

sections.title: Represent meaning as a vector
paragraphs: An embedding model maps text into a numeric vector. Nearby vectors can indicate related meanings according to that model. Use the same model and compatible dimensions for documents and queries.

The lab supplies small two-dimensional vectors to make arithmetic visible. They are invented teaching vectors, not model embeddings. The project uses a real embedding adapter or records a lexical baseline when the provider is unavailable.

sections.title: Normalize before comparing
paragraphs: A dot product multiplies corresponding values and adds them. Cosine similarity divides the dot product by both vector lengths, so a longer vector does not win merely because its numbers are larger. Handle a zero vector deliberately.

Rank by descending score and break ties consistently by document id. Limit the number of returned chunks. A threshold such as 0.7 is a teaching policy; choose a real threshold using retrieval evaluations on your corpus.

sections.title: Prepare and filter the documents
paragraphs: Split long documents into useful chunks and store source id, shop, version, and text with each vector. Avoid fragments that lose the context needed to interpret a rule. Track when policy content changes and rebuild the corresponding embeddings.
Apply permission and shop filters before returning text to the model. Similarity is not authorization. A highly similar document from another shop must remain unavailable to the caller.

sections.title: Evaluate retrieval separately
paragraphs: For each question, label which source should be found. Measure whether it appears in the top results, including paraphrases, missing answers, stale documents, and cross-shop content. Compare against a simple keyword search.
If retrieval fails, changing the answer prompt may not help. Inspect chunking, filters, model version, and ranking independently. Keep the actual retrieved ids and scores in a safe evaluation report.

exercise.title: A deterministic vector ranker
exercise.brief: Write rank(query, documents, k). Return ids in descending cosine score, tie by id. Keep scores >=0.7. Return [] for non-positive or non-integer k. The vectors are prepared teaching data.

steps.title: Rank unit vectors
steps.task: Use a dot product, descending sort, id tie-break, and k limit on the supplied unit vectors.
steps.hint: map can calculate scores; sort and slice can order and limit.

steps.title: Normalize similarity
steps.task: Use cosine similarity. Define zero-vector score as zero.
steps.hint: Divide the dot product by both lengths.

steps.title: Limit and reject weak matches
steps.task: Keep only scores >=0.7 and require a positive integer k. The zero-vector case now returns no match.

cases.label: A direct match
cases.why: The most relevant vector should rank first.

cases.label: Equal scores
cases.why: A tie has a stable order.

cases.label: Vector magnitude is irrelevant
cases.why: Normalize rather than choosing magnitude alone.

cases.label: A zero vector
cases.why: The intermediate normalization step defines a zero score.

cases.label: Invalid result count
cases.why: An invalid bound returns no results.

project.title: A policy search with permission filters
project.brief: Index a small policy corpus for two shops. Compare lexical retrieval with real embeddings if available, and label which mode each report uses.

milestones.title: Prepare sources
actions: Write returns, delivery, and hours policies.
Assign stable ids, shop ids, and versions.
Create questions with expected source ids.

milestones.title: Implement retrieval
actions: Filter by the verified shop before ranking.
Use the same embedding model for query and documents.
Handle empty, zero, and incompatible vectors.

milestones.title: Evaluate and update
actions: Record top ids for every question.
Change one policy and rebuild its index.

acceptance: Results are scoped to the verified shop.
Source ids and versions are retained.
Weak or missing matches can return empty.
Real vectors and teaching fixtures are distinguished.
A changed policy causes a verified index update.
